item.title: 智能体行为契约II：在不假设独立性的前提下认证组合可靠性
item.summary: arXiv:2608.12895v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Compositional reliability bounds for multi-agent systems multiply component reliabilities, a step licensed by a conditional-independence assumption that is routinely stated and rarely tested. We test it. Two instances of one model, in a two-agent handoff, co-fail on 90.0%
